about: Mod ping-pong round 5, batch 4 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#lote-4--tecnología-y-redstone): technology and redstone. Staging by the pingpong5tech family of tools/generate_family_balance.py: EI's tesla coil and tower take the act III alloy (wireless energy), the Dyson rail ejector the atomic alloy (endgame power, Act V).

extended_industrialization: Modern Industrialization expansion: solar boilers and panels, tesla wireless power, large and processing machines, farmer, machine chainer and electric tools
Follows MI's own circuit ladder; the tesla coil and tower take the act III alloy like every wireless-energy member, and their assembler twins are removed
industrialization_overdrive: MI multiblock builder, multi processing array, pyrolyse oven and the Vajra tool
Native: its pieces already need MI's electronic to EV tiers
dysoncubeproject: A Dyson sphere: eject solar sails into orbit and collect their power with a ray receiver
The rail ejector takes the atomic alloy (Act V, endgame power); the receiver needs ejected sails
morered: Redstone logic gates, coloured and bundled cables and a soldering table
Native; its red alloy shares c:ingots/redstone_alloy with Ender IO on purpose and is not unified
moreredxcctcompat: ComputerCraft reads and writes More Red's bundled cables

cfRelations.why: CurseForge relates Advanced Peripherals and More Red CCT to CC: Tweaked's original project (282001); the lock carries CC: Tweaked 1.120.2 from project 1676502, which provides the same computercraft mod ID their mods.toml requires ([1.119.0,) and [1.114.4,))
